item.title: ACME WorldBuilder 0.1.0
item.description:
### 📋 Changelog ## Changes
- Push landblocks to a live server through the World Patch API. ([336f540](https://github.com/Vanquish-6/ACME-AC-Map-Editor-WorldBuilder/commit/336f540b31540772d744b66ab026c46612f0ab7c)) - Add the Monster Builder: import OBJ models as creature Setups. ([fd1df02](https://github.com/Vanquish-6/ACME-AC-Map-Editor-WorldBuilder/commit/fd1df02033af25cc4784d259a430249fa953b905)) - Dungeon editor: generate from retail blueprints, stitch meeting doors, fix palette favorites. ([651291a](https://github.com/Vanquish-6/ACME-AC-Map-Editor-WorldBuilder/commit/651291a8ae142d84504054b5aaceba14db185192)) - Replace the intro and connection-screen backgrounds from the Layout editor. ([9609751](https://github.com/Vanquish-6/ACME-AC-Map-Editor-WorldBuilder/commit/9609751511c08a144d7e9ad7349bba40c332bdcd)) - Make legacy pre-ToD projects editable and export same-size cell.dat and portal.dat. ([e086f05](https://github.com/Vanquish-6/ACME-AC-Map-Editor-WorldBuilder/commit/e086f0504265cb49a0398543740e17530e9a4d1e)) - Hydrate BSP trees when loading GfxObj and CellStruct records. ([394364c](https://github.com/Vanquish-6/ACME-AC-Map-Editor-WorldBuilder/commit/394364c710b2613f56a385803f0ced01803d39bf)) - Update export-public-repo.ps1 with GitHub instructions ([a581a5a](https://github.com/Vanquish-6/ACME-AC-Map-Editor-WorldBuilder/commit/a581a5a1c77a9b12ecabe03e67084c5fc7bbdc03)) - Ignore leftover extract folders in the public tree. ([dc76cb9](https://github.com/Vanquish-6/ACME-AC-Map-Editor-WorldBuilder/commit/dc76cb9e5afb10274a9ad1a6e2e74e4bc8c5f298)) - Initial public ACME WorldBuilder. ([01ebc1f](https://github.com/Vanquish-6/ACME-AC-Map-Editor-WorldBuilder/commit/01ebc1f2f80081d090016fa9dd94f68cc620ee31))
